card.name: Significance wording in study results
card.fires_on: Words like significantly, significant, differences, higher or difference when results are being compared in drug study text. Often follows 'were' or 'no statistically'.

modes.label: Adverb after were
modes.description: The word significantly right after 'were' before a change such as higher, increased or prolonged.
modes.example: ketamine and thiopental anesthesia were<< significantly>> prolonged in rats receiving probenecid

modes.label: Statistical significance phrase
modes.description: Significant, differences or difference in the phrase 'no (statistically) significant difference'.
